content.value: The velocity vector field for the 2D flow of an ideal fluid around a cylinder is given by $\begin{array} { r } { \vec { F } ( x , y ) = A \left[ \left( 1 - \frac { x ^ { 2 } - y ^ { 2 } } { ( x ^ { 2 } + y ^ { 2 } ) ^ { 2 } } \right) \hat { \imath } - \frac { 2 x y } { ( x ^ { 2 } + y ^ { 2 } ) ^ { 2 } } \hat { \jmath } \right] } \end{array}$ for some constant $_ \mathrm { A } { > } 0$ Determine whether (i) $\vec { F }$ is irrotational (ii) $\vec { F }$ is incompressible.
